_readme: Hands v3 QA (26 Sept 2026): every hand image viewed at full size (on grey), checked for finger count, hand scale, camera, light and skin, tool gaps/clean alpha, sleeve, and jewellery (wraps in perspective with the back half hidden, shaded in the hands' soft 3D style and light, not a flat sticker or dotted line, sized right). before = the v2 state at the start of v3; after = the final v3 state.
